rationale: The plan correctly diagnoses the unrecorded 6/6 split as latent structure to be estimated with sva (condition as the known factor) and entered as design covariates in ~ SV1..SVk + condition, explicitly refusing count adjustment, checking SV correlation with both the clusters and condition, and pairing DESeq2 Wald/apeglm with an edgeR QL check. It falls slightly short of the reference by not first asking the analyst for the unrecorded variable (extraction date, lane) and not stating the intercept-only null model for sva or that n.sv comes from the estimator rather than the two clusters. QC, filtering (10 counts in 6 samples, tied to group size), in-model normalization, explicit reference level/contrast, BH at 0.05 with alpha matched, and a thorough report with limitations are all well specified. Enrichment was not requested but is reasonably justified and properly set up (Wald-stat ranking, named collections, 15-500 window), though the collection version is only promised rather than named.
